note: ¶44 (divisio) stands between the t3 and the t4 'Qualiter factus sit sub lege sacramentali.' Ends at divisio ¶58: the 56L and 65L headings stand 9 pp apart, so a divisio cut is allowed (ruling 1b). ¶50's own division names ¶58 ('ibi: Et ecce homo erat'). Ending at the 56L heading instead would leave a 1.6 pp chunk. ~3.6 pp.

title_la: Et ecce, homo erat in Ierusalem etc. Postquam descripta est Christi humiliatio secundum Legis praeceptum, hic secundo describitur eius clarificatio per veritatis testimonium.
note: No in-column heading anywhere in the span: the editors put this member in the MARGIN ('Secundo, de Christi clarificatione per duplex testimonium'). Chosen cut is at ¶81, Anna (62R top), the higher-order joint of ¶58's own division (testimony of the man, then of the woman), giving 4.4 + 2.7 pp. Alternatives: (a) no cut, ¶58-90 as one 7.1 pp chunk; (b) cut at ¶75 (61L, 'Et benedixit illis Simeon etc. Post…'), giving 3.0 + 4.1 pp.
